name: Zander
description: The zander is a popular predatory fish from the perch family. It is known for its tasty, firm flesh and its excellent hunting abilities.
habitat: Zander prefer larger, deeper lakes and slowly flowing rivers with sandy or gravelly bottoms. They often stay near the bottom.
diet: Predator - feeds mainly on smaller fish like roach, perch and ruffe
features: Sharp canine teeth in the mouth
Greenish-gray coloration with dark transverse bands
conservation: Not endangered - important commercial fish in European waters
funFact: Zander can see very well even in murky water. Their large eyes have a special layer that amplifies the available light - similar to cats!
